evidence: Searched the reply and the written doc for system facts absent from the user's message and the original doc. Doc line 29 asserts a download mechanism: "O endpoint `GET /exports/<job_id>/download` lê o arquivo do bucket, então qualquer worker atende o download." The user never said how the download works after the move, and the run itself lists it as unknown (doc line 55 / reply line 11: "O download continua passando pela API ou o usuário recebe um link direto para o bucket?"), so line 29 asserts as fact what the run treats as open. Also doc line 31 asserts retention "Os arquivos ficam 7 dias; um cron apaga os mais antigos." for the bucket while marking it open, and doc line 42 asserts "agora o serviço precisa de ambas" (new credentials and retention policy) as a current fact about the system, which the user did not establish.
